name: Senjuin Shirou
source:
A noble who has the qualities of a 'Master'.
He's a handsome, smart, and athletic man with no faults.
A kind honor student who is trusted by teachers and other students alike.
He's [url=/c42970]Asagayachi's[/url] cousin.
